name: VDC
description: VDC is a video detailed captioning benchmark with over one thousand carefully annotated structured captions designed to evaluate comprehensive and coherent textual descriptions of video content. It includes a new LLM-assisted evaluation metric, VDCscore, that correlates better with human judgments.
reputation: A recent video captioning benchmark that is gaining attention for structured caption evaluation, but it is not yet widely established as a standard benchmark.
notes: Introduces a token merging strategy for efficient video captioning and a new evaluation metric based on question-answer pairs.
